SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE priority = 4 AND is_deleted = false
SELECT s.status_name as statusName, COUNT(p.post_id) as count FROM post_status s LEFT JOIN post p ON s.status_id = p.status_id AND p.is_deleted = false GROUP BY s.status_id, s.status_name
SELECT CASE priority WHEN 1 THEN '낮음' WHEN 2 THEN '보통' WHEN 3 THEN '높음' WHEN 4 THEN '긴급' END as priorityName, COUNT(*) as count FROM post WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY priority

SELECT c.category_name as categoryName, COUNT(p.post_id) as count FROM post_category c LEFT JOIN post p ON c.category_id = p.category_id AND p.is_deleted = false GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT p.post_id as postId, p.title as title, p.priority as priority, s.status_name as statusName, p.created_at as createdAt, u.name as authorName FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN post_status s ON p.status_id = s.status_id WHERE p.assigned_user_id = #{userId} AND p.status_id != 3 AND p.is_deleted = false ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 5
